note: Their own server renders this board and their page drops it straight in: U("js-dtn-bids", "/ajax/homepage/dtn-cash-bids"). No widget, no key, no JavaScript. The per-location variant is /ajax/pages/dtn-cash-bids?location=<id> and is how the other FCS locations get added once their ids are read off the locations page; /ajax/pages/dtn-cash-bids with no location returned 70 bytes, so the id is not optional there. Their second heading drops the town -- "Sioux Center Corn Bids" then plain "Soybean Bids" -- and the adapter inherits it only because every heading that names a town names the same one. Cash is 2dp against quarter-cent futures, so rows sit up to half a cent off the identity; cashRoundingCents declares that.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board at Sioux Center, read from their website. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
